selection.method: Conservative ID/URL/same-board-title/identical-long-description groups; representative by SHA256(seed+caseID), artifact path tie-break. Take up to 15 approved and 10 pending representatives. Fill shortage from excluded with source coverage, three candidates per observed lexical pay/semantic-term feature, then least-used source and seeded order. Largest-remainder proportional split allocation, then independent seeded order within each machine stratum.

limitations: Prospective public API snapshot, not recovery of historical source descriptions.
Sampling strata and pay-word markers are machine/lexical data, not Ground Truth.
Same-title and exact-description grouping is conservative; real distinct requisitions may be grouped. Residual semantic duplicates remain possible.
No source expansion. Approved/pending quotas cannot be met after conservative grouping; excluded cases fill the 40-case target.
No independently verified base-pay positives, total-pay negatives, evidence-support labels, or comparison judgments exist yet.
No multiple structured bands were observed; no artificial multi-band or estimate/repost cases are added.
Comparison partners remain blank: source-only preparation does not establish eligibility, market or level comparability. Approve fixed pairs before labeling.
API fields are preserved in full as supplied; capture cannot establish whether the upstream publisher omitted content.
Shareable inventory omits titles, descriptions, source excerpts, contact data, and per-case machine strata to avoid exposing raw material and cueing reviewers.

verification.scope: Evidence/identity/hash/CSV/split/privacy checks; not Ground Truth or accuracy.

privacy.sharedFields: Case/source/job IDs, split/group metadata, aggregate machine/lexical counts, relative artifact paths and checksums only; no titles, descriptions, excerpts, source contact information or per-case machine decisions.
privacy.reviewBlinding: Give reviewers the local source-only CSV and evidence packets, not the machine candidate inventory or sampling ledger.
